description: This file contains helper functions and templates for testing and mocking in the PyTorch codebase, specifically related to tensor creation, operator invocation, and dispatch key handling.

methods.name: makeStack
methods.description: Creates a vector of c10::IValue from variadic inputs.

methods.name: dummyTensor
methods.description: Creates a dummy tensor with specified dispatch key set or dispatch key, optionally requiring gradient.

methods.name: callOp
methods.description: Calls a boxed operator with given arguments and returns the stack.

methods.name: callOpUnboxed
methods.description: Calls an unboxed operator with given arguments and returns the result.

methods.name: callOpUnboxedWithDispatchKey
methods.description: Calls an unboxed operator with a specific dispatch key and arguments.

methods.name: callOpUnboxedWithPrecomputedDispatchKeySet
methods.description: Calls an unboxed operator with a precomputed dispatch key set and arguments.

methods.name: expectDoesntFindKernel
methods.description: Asserts that a kernel for a given operator name and dispatch key is not found.

methods.name: expectDoesntFindOperator
methods.description: Asserts that an operator schema for a given name is not found.

methods.name: expectThrows
methods.description: Asserts that a functor throws an exception containing a specific message.

methods.name: expectListEquals
methods.description: Checks if expected list equals actual list, supporting different container types.

methods.name: extractDispatchKey
methods.description: Extracts the dispatch key from a tensor.
